    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
    LIMIT 1

    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency

    transactions_1k t

    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY

    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

    tc.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    TopCustomer tc ON t.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY 
    tc.CustomerID, c.Currency;

        lap,

        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,

        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0 AS total_seconds

)

FROM ConvertedTimes;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes, seconds, and milliseconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Handle missing milliseconds by using COALESCE to default to 0
        COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER), 0) AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER), 0) / 1000.0 AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM ConvertedTimes;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH bond_details AS (
    SELECT 
        b.bond_id,
        b.bond_type,
        a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
        a1.element AS atom1_element,
        a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
        a2.element AS atom2_element,
        CASE 
            WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
            WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
            ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
        END AS bond_classification
    FROM 
        bond b
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN 
        atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_5')
),
molecule_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE 
        m.molecule_id = (SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id FROM atom a WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_2')
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    bd.bond_id,
    bd.bond_type,
    bd.atom1_id,
    bd.atom1_element,
    bd.atom2_id,
    bd.atom2_element,
    bd.bond_classification,
    mc.atom_count,
    mc.bond_count
FROM 
    bond_details bd
JOIN 
    molecule_counts mc ON bd.bond_id LIKE mc.molecule_id || '%';

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000, 0) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +

    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t

    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

        ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )

    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 1), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000, 0) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM ConvertedTimes;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        milliseconds,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + -- Convert minutes to seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) + -- Convert seconds to seconds
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds -- Convert milliseconds to seconds, default to 0 if not present
    FROM lapTimes
),
FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS INTEGER) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS INTEGER), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS INTEGER), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, res.time
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
TimeInSeconds AS (
    SELECT year,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CASE
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN time) > 0 THEN
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, '.', 1), ':', 3) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0 +
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000000.0
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM ChampionTimes
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM TimeInSeconds
GROUP BY year;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM ConvertedTimes;

           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000

    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)

FROM ChampionTimes

SELECT 
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,

    free_meal_category,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count

    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS free_meal_category
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
        AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700

        free_meal_category

    AVG(CAST("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS avg_free_meal_percentage,

sql:
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS Spending ON t.CustomerID = Spending.CustomerID
WHERE 
    Spending.TotalSpending = (
        SELECT MAX(TotalSpending)
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
        ) AS MaxSpending
    )
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS Spending ON t.CustomerID = Spending.CustomerID
WHERE 
    Spending.TotalSpending = (
        SELECT MAX(TotalSpending)
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
        ) AS MaxSpending
    )
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t

    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k

        SELECT MAX(TotalSpending)
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
        ) AS MaxSpending
    )

    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN 
                   CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
),
FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS INTEGER) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS INTEGER), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS INTEGER), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

    FROM ConvertedTimes

LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    b.bond_id,
    b.bond_type,
    a1.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    a2.atom_id AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    m.atom_count,
    m.bond_count
FROM 
    bond b
JOIN 
    connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        m.molecule_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
    FROM 
        molecule m
    JOIN 
        bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN 
        connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN 
        atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
    WHERE 
        b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_5')
    GROUP BY 
        m.molecule_id
) AS counts ON m.molecule_id = counts.molecule_id
WHERE 
    b.bond_id IN ('TR000_2_4', 'TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_5');

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
),
FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS INTEGER) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS INTEGER), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS INTEGER), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000, 0) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;
exec_sql: SELECT r.year, AVG(CAST(CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INT) * 3600 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INT) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INT) + CASE WHEN STRPOS(res.time, '.') > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INT) / 1000 ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(18, 6))) AS avg_time_seconds FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON r.raceId = res.raceId WHERE res.position = 1 AND r.year < 1975 AND NOT res.time IS NULL GROUP BY r.year ORDER BY r.year ASC

    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),

    SELECT MAX(TotalSpending) AS MaxSpending

    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t

    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN 
    CustomerSpending cs ON t.CustomerID = cs.CustomerID
JOIN 
    MaxSpending ms ON cs.TotalSpending = ms.MaxSpending
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

sql:
WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
),
FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

FROM total_members;

sql:
WITH filtered_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)",
        "Charter School (Y/N)",
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)"
    FROM 
        frpm
    WHERE 
        "County Name" = 'Los Angeles' 
        AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 
        AND "FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
),
sat_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 AS avg_sat_score
    FROM 
        satscores
),
categorized_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        "Free Meal Count (K-12)",
        CASE 
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 600 THEN 'Very High'
            WHEN "Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500 THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Moderate'
        END AS free_meal_category
    FROM 
        filtered_schools
)

SELECT 
    AVG("Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_percentage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
    AVG(sat_scores.avg_sat_score) AS avg_sat_score,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN free_meal_category = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS high_category_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN free_meal_category = 'Very High' THEN 1 END) AS very_high_category_count
FROM 
    filtered_schools
JOIN 
    sat_scores ON filtered_schools.CDSCode = sat_scores.cds
JOIN 
    categorized_schools ON filtered_schools."Free Meal Count (K-12)" = categorized_schools."Free Meal Count (K-12)";

    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT time
FROM ConvertedTimes
JOIN FastestLap ON ConvertedTimes.total_seconds = FastestLap.fastest_lap_time_seconds
LIMIT 1;

FROM ChampionTimes

sql:
WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
),
FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT z.state, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE m.position = 'Member' AND z.state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont')
    GROUP BY z.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Member'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'New Jersey') / total_member_count * 100.0 AS nj_percentage,
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'Vermont') / total_member_count * 100.0 AS vt_percentage,
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'New Jersey') / total_member_count * 100.0 -
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'Vermont') / total_member_count * 100.0 AS percentage_difference
FROM total_members;

    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t

    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
    FROM transactions_1k

        SELECT MAX(TotalSpending)
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
        ) AS MaxSpending
    )

    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency

        SELECT MAX(TotalSpending)
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
        ) AS MaxSpending

sql:
WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
),
FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

)

FROM TimeInSeconds

sql:
SELECT 
    schools."School Name",
    schools.Street || ', ' || schools.City || ', ' || schools.State || ' ' || schools.Zip AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools.Website,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000, 0) AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH ConvertedTimes AS (
    SELECT
        raceId,
        driverId,
        lap,
        position,
        -- Split the time into minutes and seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) AS minutes,
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) AS seconds,
        -- Check for the presence of milliseconds and handle accordingly
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER)
            ELSE
                0
        END AS milliseconds,
        -- Convert to total seconds
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) +
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2)) > 0 THEN
                CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS INTEGER) / 1000.0
            ELSE
                0
        END AS total_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
),
FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_seconds) AS fastest_lap_time_seconds
    FROM ConvertedTimes
)
SELECT
    CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds / 60) AS VARCHAR) || ':' ||
    LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(fastest_lap_time_seconds % 60) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '.' ||
    LPAD(CAST((fastest_lap_time_seconds * 1000) % 1000 AS VARCHAR), 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

WITH ChampionTimes AS (
    SELECT r.year, 
           res.time,
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
           CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
           CASE 
               WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
               ELSE 0
           END AS time_in_seconds
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
    AND r.year < 1975
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT year, AVG(time_in_seconds) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM ChampionTimes
GROUP BY year;

WITH member_counts AS (
    SELECT z.state, COUNT(*) AS member_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
    WHERE m.position = 'Member' AND z.state IN ('New Jersey', 'Vermont')
    GROUP BY z.state
),
total_members AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_member_count
    FROM member
    WHERE position = 'Member'
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'New Jersey') / total_member_count * 100.0 -
    COALESCE((SELECT member_count FROM member_counts WHERE state = 'Vermont') / total_member_count * 100.0, 0) AS percentage_difference
FROM total_members;

    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2,

    connected c
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE 
    c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2';

SELECT 
    schools."School Name",
    schools.Street || ', ' || schools.City || ', ' || schools.State || ' ' || schools.Zip AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools.Website,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count

    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +

SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

sql:
SELECT 
    c.bond_id,
    c.atom_id AS atom1_id,
    a1.element AS atom1_element,
    c.atom_id2 AS atom2_id,
    a2.element AS atom2_element,
    b.bond_type,
    CASE 
        WHEN a1.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl' THEN 'Contains Chlorine'
        WHEN a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'c' THEN 'Carbon-Carbon Bond'
        ELSE 'Other Bond Type'
    END AS bond_classification,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS atom_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = b.molecule_id) AS bond_count
FROM 
    connected c
JOIN 
    bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN 
    atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN 
    atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE 
    c.bond_id IN ('TR000_1_2', 'TR000_2_3', 'TR000_2_4', 'TR000_2_5');

SELECT 
    schools."School Name",
    schools.Street || ', ' || schools.City || ', ' || schools.State || ' ' || schools.Zip AS "Unabbreviated Mailing Address",
    schools.Website,
    frpm."Enrollment (K-12)",
    frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)",
    frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
    satscores.NumTstTakr,
    satscores.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" > 70 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 20 THEN 'High-performing despite high FRPM'
        WHEN frpm."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" < 30 AND (satscores.NumGE1500 * 100.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'
        ELSE 'Normal performance'
    END AS Performance
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN 
    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds
WHERE 
    "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
ORDER BY 
    "FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT 
    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) / SUM(t.Amount) AS AveragePricePerItem,
    c.Currency
FROM 
    transactions_1k t
JOIN 
    customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    t.CustomerID = (
        SELECT CustomerID
        FROM (
            SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Price) AS TotalSpending
            FROM transactions_1k
            GROUP BY CustomerID
        ) AS Spending
        ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
GROUP BY 
    t.CustomerID, c.Currency;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

    schools.Website,

    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds

SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

    satscores ON frpm."School Code" = satscores.cds

    schools.Website,

    t.CustomerID AS TopSpendingCustomerID,

    c.Currency

        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(COALESCE(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 3), '0'), '.', 1) AS INTEGER), 0) +

    FROM lapTimes

        LPAD((fastest_lap_seconds * 1000) % 1000::INTEGER, 3, '0'),
        'HH24:MI:SS.FF3'
    ) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN 
                       CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;

WITH FastestLap AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(COALESCE(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 3), '0'), '.', 1) AS INTEGER), 0) +
        COALESCE(CAST(SPLIT_PART(COALESCE(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 3), '0'), '.', 2) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 1000, 0)
    ) AS fastest_lap_seconds
    FROM lapTimes
)
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(
        (fastest_lap_seconds / 3600)::INTEGER || ':' ||
        (fastest_lap_seconds % 3600 / 60)::INTEGER || ':' ||
        (fastest_lap_seconds % 60)::INTEGER || '.' ||
        LPAD((fastest_lap_seconds * 1000) % 1000::INTEGER, 3, '0'),
        'HH24:MI:SS.FF3'
    ) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM FastestLap;

sql:
SELECT r.year, 
       AVG(
           CAST(
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
               CAST(SPLIT_PART(res.time, ':', 3) AS INTEGER) +
               CASE 
                   WHEN POSITION('.' IN res.time) > 0 THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(res.time, '.', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) / 1000
                   ELSE 0
               END AS DECIMAL(18, 6)
           )
       ) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
AND r.year < 1975
AND res.time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year;
